observations: Photo 0 shows a wall-mounted flat-screen TV with a silver bezel; on-screen text reads "SAMSUNG QLED" and "43Q60R" with SmartThings and Ambient Mode options visible.
Photo 1 shows the same TV displaying a coral reef image; on-screen text reads "SAMSUNG QLED" and "43Q60R".
Photo 2 shows the same TV displaying a yellow snake; on-screen text reads "SAMSUNG QLED" and "43Q60R" with VDE and Dolby logos visible.
All three photos show the TV powered on and producing an image.
A "POSTED ON JIJI" watermark appears in photos 0 and 2.

SmartThings interface visible in photos 0 and 1
subjective condition claim not provable from photos

risks.proof: video of TV powering from standby, navigating menus, and showing all inputs
photo of remote control with the TV

risks.risk: stand or legs missing because TV appears wall-mounted
risks.proof: photo of stand or seller confirmation of inclusion

risks.risk: HDMI, USB, or other ports damaged
risks.proof: video showing each port working with a connected device

risks.risk: screen has dead pixels or lines not visible in still photos
risks.proof: close-up video of screen showing solid colors
photo of rear label showing manufacture date
risks.if_unproven: priced as older or unknown year

proof_requests: Video of the TV powering on, opening the menu, and switching between inputs
Photo of the rear label showing serial number and manufacture date
Photo of the remote control and stand if included
Close-up video of the screen displaying solid red, green, blue, and white to check for dead pixels
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Samsung QLED 43Q60R that is powered on, so it can be priced at its worst case while unproven claims remain unverified.
